r2_canonical_tree_inventory.algorithm: sha256 of the newline-terminated output of: find . -type f -print0 | LC_ALL=C sort -z | xargs -0 shasum -a 256, evaluated from the r2 tree root

rejection_reason.summary: The frozen r2 static packet was mechanically valid, but its deep staged validator compared parsed JSON topology dictionaries directly against integer-valued runtime dictionaries. Godot parses JSON numbers as floats, so the validator rejected exact integral topology receipts before telemetry and exposed that its round-trip contract had not been rehearsed end to end.
rejection_reason.source_defect: strict Variant dictionary equality treated JSON 735.0 as unequal to runtime integer 735
rejection_reason.required_correction: fieldwise finite integral numeric validation plus a complete disposable disk-roundtrip rehearsal of all three stages

authority_boundary: No r2 byte may be used to authorize production promotion, recognition credit, an accepted evidence ledger entry, or a shipped package. The entire r2 tree is retained only as an immutable rejected audit artifact.
